notices.title: Xbox Game Pass Loses 10 Games Today, But It's Not All Bad News
notices.contentSnippet: Today marks one of the largest Xbox Game Pass departure waves of 2026, but there is still some good news for Microsoft's subscribers.

notices.title: 'Yes, that's Counter-Strike on a PSP!': Modder gets favorite PC FPS working on Sony's 22-year-old handheld console
notices.contentSnippet: That's one way to introduce a new lease on life to original hardware.

notices.title: Monster Hunter Wilds is getting a permanent price cut less than 18 months after launch
notices.contentSnippet: As well as stuffing its ridiculous amount of DLC into new bundles.

notices.title: Microsoft Deletes User's 25-Year-Old Account With Thousands of Dollars in Games
notices.contentSnippet: A user loses 25 years of data and all the games they purchased after Microsoft permanently suspends their account and calls the action 'irreversible.'

notices.title: Pokemon GO Adding Fan-Favorite Mega Evolution In August Event
notices.contentSnippet: Pokemon GO confirms the long-requested debut of a popular Mega Evolution as part of an upcoming Super Mega Raid limited event.

notices.title: PS5 is Getting a Brand-New Stardew Valley-Like Farming Sim Game on September 24
notices.contentSnippet: PS5 owners will be able to enjoy a brand new farming simulator that's similar to Stardew Valley when it releases on September 24.

notices.title: GTA 6 isn't on PC at launch because it's 'always better to start with the constraints', suggests former Rockstar producer
notices.contentSnippet: "It's not that we don't care about PC."

notices.title: That annoying day one DLC in Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced was less than 3% of its initial Steam sales, but hey, $1 million is $1 million
notices.contentSnippet: Still a decent haul of dubloons.
